GreenTEC Pro CF combines the biodegradable performance of GreenTEC Pro with the added stiffness of carbon fiber reinforcement. Carbon fiber content significantly increases rigidity, allowing models to withstand high loads while remaining genuinely lightweight, a real advantage for weight-sensitive applications. It also improves heat resistance over standard GreenTEC Pro, and produces a distinctive matte surface with visible carbon fiber texture. As with all carbon-fiber-reinforced materials, this added stiffness comes with a trade-off in impact resistance compared to standard GreenTEC Pro. A hardened nozzle is required for printing, due to the abrasive nature of the carbon fiber content.

GreenTEC Pro CF offers significantly greater rigidity and improved heat resistance than standard GreenTEC Pro, along with a genuinely lightweight strength profile. As with all carbon-fiber-reinforced materials, this added stiffness comes with a trade-off in impact resistance, standard GreenTEC Pro's slight flexibility makes it more resistant to impact, while GreenTEC Pro CF is better suited to rigid, load-bearing applications where stiffness matters more than shock absorption.
